news.titleEn: Stock market today: Nasdaq and S&P 500 rebound, Dow slips to cap bruising week for AI stocks
news.conclusionEn: US stocks partly rebounded on Friday after Thursday's AI-led crash, with the Nasdaq up 1.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.3% while the Dow fell 0.5%.
news.conclusionZh: AI股暴跌次日美股反弹，纳指涨1.1%，道指仍跌
news.whyEn: Thursday's selloff erased about $3 trillion in value; whether chip stocks stabilize will shape global tech and AI-linked portfolios.
news.whyZh: 前一天蒸发约3万亿美元，芯片股能否企稳影响全球科技持仓
news.detailEn: The semiconductor index, which dropped 12% on Thursday in its worst day since March 2020, recovered about 4% as Nvidia, AMD and Micron bounced. The selloff was triggered by fears that Democrats' midterm wins will bring tighter rules on AI data center construction. Even with Friday's gains, the S&P 500 logged its worst week since June. Investors are now watching CoreWeave and Nebius earnings next week as a test of AI infrastructure demand.
news.detailZh: 费城半导体指数周四暴跌12%，创2020年3月以来最差单日表现，周五随英伟达、AMD、美光反弹回升约4%。此轮抛售源于市场担心民主党中期选举获胜后会收紧AI数据中心建设监管。即便周五反弹，标普500仍录得6月以来最差单周。下周CoreWeave和Nebius财报将检验AI基础设施需求是否依旧强劲。

news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield rises after much stronger-than-expected October jobs report
news.conclusionEn: The US added 165,000 jobs in October, nearly triple forecasts, unemployment fell to 4.1%, and Treasury yields rose.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10月新增16.5万就业远超预期，美债收益率上升
news.whyEn: A hot labor market raises the odds of a Fed rate hike in December to about 77%, pressuring stocks, mortgages and borrowing costs.
news.whyZh: 就业强劲令美联储12月加息概率升至约77%，压制股市和贷款成本
news.detailEn: Economists had expected only about 59,000 new jobs, after a weak 29,000 gain in September. The 10-year yield climbed to about 4.86% and the 2-year to about 4.52%. Fed funds futures now price a 77% chance of a quarter-point hike at the December 9 meeting, up from 66% a day earlier. A strong labor market gives the Fed little reason to ease while inflation remains sticky.
news.detailZh: 经济学家原本预期仅新增约5.9万个岗位，9月更只有2.9万。10年期美债收益率升至约4.86%，2年期升至约4.52%。联邦基金期货显示，美联储12月9日会议加息25个基点的概率升至77%，前一日为66%。在通胀仍顽固的情况下，强劲的就业市场让美联储几乎没有放松的理由。

news.titleEn: Oil prices tumble for the week as investors weigh Iran conflict risk after midterm elections
news.conclusionEn: Brent fell about 16% this week to around $98 a barrel, its steepest weekly drop in years, as hopes for US-Iran diplomacy grew.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油本周大跌约16%，收于约98美元
news.whyEn: Oil drives inflation, airline and shipping costs, and energy stocks; prices could spike back above $100 if fighting resumes.
news.whyZh: 油价牵动通胀和航运成本，若战事重启可能再破100美元
news.detailEn: Brent settled at $98.32 and WTI at $90.83 on Friday, with WTI down nearly 13% for the week. Iran reportedly sent a nuclear proposal to Washington via Qatar, fueling hopes of a deal. But Iran also reported three more tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday. Rapidan Energy's Bob McNally put the chance of fighting resuming at 80%, which could push prices above $100 again.
news.detailZh: 周五布伦特收于98.32美元，WTI收于90.83美元，WTI单周跌近13%。据报伊朗通过卡塔尔向华盛顿递交了核问题方案，提振了达成协议的希望。但伊朗也报告周四霍尔木兹海峡又有三艘油轮遇袭。Rapidan能源的McNally认为战事重启概率达80%，届时油价可能重回100美元以上。

news.titleEn: Russia to UAE, Iran steps up diplomacy amid Trump threats: What we know
news.conclusionEn: Iran sent a new peace proposal via Qatar and courted Russia and Gulf states, while Trump said the US may have to "destroy the rest" of Iran.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗经卡塔尔递交和平方案，特朗普威胁再度打击
news.whyEn: Whether talks or strikes win out will decide the fate of the Strait of Hormuz, global oil supply and Gulf stability.
news.whyZh: 谈判还是开战，将决定霍尔木兹海峡与全球原油供应走向
news.detailEn: Tehran's proposal is conditional on seven demands, including sanctions relief, unfrozen assets and an end to the US naval blockade around Hormuz. Foreign Minister Araghchi held calls with the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Turkey, Qatar and Oman. A senior Iranian envoy met Putin, and Russia reportedly agreed to supply missile launchers. Qatar's emir urged Trump on Friday to pursue a comprehensive agreement.
news.detailZh: 伊朗的方案附带七项条件，包括解除制裁、解冻资产、结束美国对霍尔木兹海峡周边的海上封锁。外长阿拉格齐与阿联酋、沙特、科威特、土耳其、卡塔尔和阿曼通话。伊朗高级特使会见普京，据报俄方同意提供导弹发射装置。卡塔尔埃米尔周五与特朗普通话，敦促达成全面协议。

news.titleEn: Opposition to AI data centers in the midterms foreshadows tougher regulations ahead
news.conclusionEn: Democratic governors who won on anti-data-center platforms, plus local referendums, point to tighter limits on AI data center construction.
news.conclusionZh: 中期选举反数据中心情绪高涨，AI建设或迎更严监管
news.whyEn: This is the policy risk behind the AI stock selloff; it could slow capex for chipmakers, cloud providers and power utilities.
news.whyZh: 这是AI股暴跌的政策根源，或拖慢芯片、云和电力投资
news.detailEn: Newly elected Democratic governors in Texas, Ohio, Georgia, Nevada and Iowa campaigned heavily against data centers' energy and water use. Of 34 winning governors, 32 back stronger regulation and 12 support bans or moratoriums. In local votes, 44 of 45 completed referendums approved restrictions. Texas, projected to be the world's largest data center market by 2030, makes the shift especially significant for the industry.
news.detailZh: 德州、俄亥俄、佐治亚、内华达和爱荷华新当选的民主党州长都曾猛烈抨击数据中心的耗电与耗水问题。34位胜选州长中32位支持加强监管，12位支持禁令或暂停建设。地方公投中，已完成的45项里有44项通过了限制措施。德州预计到2030年将成为全球最大数据中心市场，其政治转向对行业影响尤为重大。

news.titleEn: Moderna raises 2026 outlook as CEO says newer vaccines are gaining traction
news.conclusionEn: Moderna posted Q3 revenue of $1.31 billion and a surprise profit, and raised its 2026 revenue growth outlook to 15%-25%.
news.conclusionZh: Moderna三季度意外盈利，上调全年营收增长指引
news.whyEn: It signals a possible turnaround for a vaccine maker that had been shrinking since the pandemic, lifting biotech sentiment.
news.whyZh: 疫情后持续萎缩的疫苗公司或迎拐点，提振生物科技板块
news.detailEn: Revenue beat forecasts of about $885 million, and earnings of 38 cents a share compared with an expected loss of $1.25. The company had previously guided to growth of up to 10%. CEO Stéphane Bancel credited new products, including its next-generation Covid vaccine, and expansion in Canada, the UK and Asia. Shares rose about 7% midday.
news.detailZh: 营收大幅超过约8.85亿美元的预期，每股盈利0.38美元，而市场原本预期每股亏损1.25美元。公司此前的全年增长指引为最多10%。CEO班塞尔将业绩归功于新一代新冠疫苗等新产品，以及在加拿大、英国和亚洲的扩张。股价盘中上涨约7%。

news.titleEn: Stocks making the biggest moves midday: Nvidia, Moderna, IonQ, Airbnb, Firefly Aerospace & more
news.conclusionEn: Earnings split sharply: Lam Research jumped 9% on a $25 billion buyback, while DraftKings fell 27%, Axon 18% and Microchip 14% on weak results.
news.whyEn: In a jittery market, companies that miss or guide lower are being punished heavily, so stock-specific risk is high.
news.whyZh: 市场情绪脆弱，业绩不及预期的公司遭重罚，个股风险高
news.detailEn: Lam Research's board authorized a $25 billion share buyback, helping chip-equipment stocks recover. IonQ rose 17% after raising its revenue outlook, and Firefly Aerospace soared 30% on a $1.3 billion engine deal with AST SpaceMobile. On the downside, DraftKings posted a wider-than-expected loss, Axon missed estimates and gave weak guidance, and Microchip's outlook disappointed. The swings show investors rewarding clear growth and punishing any shortfall.
news.detailZh: Lam Research董事会批准250亿美元股票回购，带动半导体设备股回升。IonQ上调营收指引后大涨17%，Firefly Aerospace因与AST SpaceMobile签下13亿美元发动机合同飙升30%。下跌方面，DraftKings亏损扩大超预期，Axon业绩不及预期且指引疲弱，Microchip的展望也令人失望。这种剧烈分化说明投资者奖励确定增长、严惩任何不及预期。

news.titleEn: Hoax bomb threats repeatedly disrupt flights across Europe this week. Here's what we know
news.conclusionEn: At least 27 European flights were hit by hoax bomb threats on Thursday alone, forcing diversions and fighter-jet escorts.
news.conclusionZh: 欧洲单日至少27个航班遭炸弹恐吓，多架被迫备降
news.whyEn: The wave disrupts travel and airlines, and authorities are weighing whether it is part of Russia-linked hybrid attacks.
news.whyZh: 冲击航空出行，当局正评估是否与俄罗斯混合战有关
news.detailEn: Aer Lingus, Finnair, Wizz Air, LOT and Air France were among the carriers affected, with incidents around London, Copenhagen, Dublin, Helsinki and Prague. Security checks found no explosives in any case. The EU activated an aviation-security information-sharing mechanism, and police in several countries are investigating. It followed a similar wave targeting seven planes on Tuesday.
news.detailZh: 受影响的航司包括爱尔兰航空、芬兰航空、威兹航空、波兰航空和法航，涉及伦敦、哥本哈根、都柏林、赫尔辛基和布拉格等地。安检均未发现爆炸物。欧盟启动了航空安全信息共享机制，多国警方展开调查。此前周二已有7架客机遭到类似威胁。

businessTips.explanationEn: Chesterton's Fence says you should not remove a rule, process or policy until you understand why it was put there. Many seemingly pointless rules exist to prevent a problem that is now invisible precisely because the rule works. Understanding the original reason lets you decide whether it still applies. It is a useful check against over-eager "efficiency" changes.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「切斯特顿的栅栏」指出：在弄清楚一条规则、流程或政策当初为何设立之前，不要贸然取消它。很多看似多余的规定，恰恰是因为它在起作用，所以它要防范的问题才看不见。弄清初衷后，才能判断它是否仍然必要。这是防止为了「提效」而草率改动的好方法。
businessTips.exampleEn: A new manager wants to scrap the rule that every refund over $200 needs a second sign-off. Before cutting it, they learn it was added after a staff member issued fake refunds. They keep the check but automate it, saving time without reopening the risk.
businessTips.exampleZh: 新经理想取消「200元以上退款需第二人审批」的规定。动手前他了解到，这条规则是在一名员工伪造退款后才加上的。于是他保留审批、改为系统自动提醒，既省时间又不重新打开漏洞。

businessTips.explanationEn: Good-Better-Best pricing offers the same product or service in three tiers instead of one price. The basic tier captures price-sensitive buyers, the middle tier is designed to be the most popular, and the premium tier makes the middle look reasonable and captures customers willing to pay more. It raises average order value without forcing anyone to pay more. For small sellers, it is one of the easiest ways to increase revenue from the same traffic.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「好-更好-最好」定价是把同一产品或服务分成三档，而不是只给一个价格。基础档吸引价格敏感的客户，中间档设计成最受欢迎的主力，高端档让中间档显得划算，同时拿下愿意多付钱的客户。它能在不强迫任何人多花钱的前提下提高客单价。对小卖家来说，这是用同样流量多赚钱的最简单方法之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: A home-cleaning side business offers Standard ($120), Deep Clean with oven and fridge ($180), and Premium with linen change and restocking ($240). Most customers pick the middle tier, and average revenue per job rises from $120 to about $170.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个家政副业推出三档：标准清洁120元、含烤箱冰箱的深度清洁180元、含换床品和补货的尊享档240元。多数客户选中间档，每单平均收入从120元升到约170元。

businessTips.explanationEn: Maximum drawdown measures the largest peak-to-trough fall in an investment's value before it reaches a new high. It shows the worst loss an investor would have suffered by buying at the top and selling at the bottom. Returns alone can hide how painful a strategy is to hold; drawdown reveals that. Large drawdowns also need much bigger gains to recover: a 50% loss requires a 100% gain to break even.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最大回撤衡量的是一项投资从最高点跌到最低点的最大跌幅（在创新高之前）。它反映了一个在高点买入、在低点卖出的投资者最多会亏多少。只看收益率会掩盖持有过程有多煎熬，而回撤能揭示这一点。回撤越大，回本越难：亏50%需要涨100%才能回到原点。
businessTips.exampleEn: After this week's AI rout, a chip-heavy fund may be down 25% from its peak while a balanced fund is down 6%. Even if both earned similar returns over five years, the first requires much stronger nerves. Checking drawdown helps you choose a portfolio you can actually hold through a selloff.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周AI股暴跌后，一只重仓芯片的基金可能较高点回撤25%，而股债平衡基金只回撤6%。即使两者五年收益相近，前者需要强大得多的心理承受力。看最大回撤能帮你选出在暴跌中真正拿得住的组合。
